model_annotation: This plot illustrates the number of issued decisions for construction new buildings from 2012 to 2022. The x-axis, labeled with years from 2012 to 2022, represents a linear scale with tick intervals of one year. The y-axis, labeled with the number of decisions in thousands, ranges from 170 to 8169, with tick intervals of 5000. There are three lines displayed: “Административни” (Administrative) is a solid brown line that begins at a value of 4238 and decreases to 4685; “Други” (Other) is a gray line that begins at a value of 4120 and decreases to 4631; and “Жилищни” (Residential) is a dark green line that begins at a value of 170 and decreases to 7047.
